title: Palace denies politicking claims over P500-M fund for Jesse Robredo Coliseum in Naga
summary: Malacañang on Thursday denied insinuations that the Marcos administration’s decision to allocate P500 million for the retrofitting of the Jesse Robredo Coliseum in Naga was politically motivated.
